description: This file defines data models related to notes within a note-keeping backend system. It includes entity classes and request/response payload classes for creating, updating, and returning notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note entity with properties such as Id, Title, Content, CreatedAtUtc, and UpdatedAtUtc.

classes.name: CreateNoteRequest
classes.description: Payload class for creating a new note, with validation attributes for Title and Content.

classes.name: UpdateNoteRequest
classes.description: Payload class for updating an existing note, with validation attributes for Title and Content.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: Response class for returning note data, includes a static method for converting a Note entity to a NoteResponse.

methods.name: NoteResponse.From
methods.description: Static method converting a Note entity into a NoteResponse object.
